bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate the historic Hibbing High School Auditorium in the city of Hibbing.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HISTORIC HIBBING HIGH SCHOOL AUDITORIUM RENOVATION. +]

[+$785,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $785,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Hibbing School District (Independent School District No. 701) to preserve and renovate the historic Hibbing High School Auditorium, including repairs to the Barton pipe organ, stage, stage curtain, projector booth, electrical, dressing rooms, and sprinkler system and other repairs and renovations to the historic auditorium. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate the historic Hibbing High School Auditorium in the city of Hibbing.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HISTORIC HIBBING HIGH SCHOOL AUDITORIUM RENOVATION.

$785,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $785,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Hibbing School District (Independent School District No. 701) to preserve and renovate the historic Hibbing High School Auditorium, including repairs to the Barton pipe organ, stage, stage curtain, projector booth, electrical, dressing rooms, and sprinkler system and other repairs and renovations to the historic auditorium.
additions: APPROPRIATION; HISTORIC HIBBING HIGH SCHOOL AUDITORIUM RENOVATION.

$785,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $785,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Hibbing School District (Independent School District No. 701) to preserve and renovate the historic Hibbing High School Auditorium, including repairs to the Barton pipe organ, stage, stage curtain, projector booth, electrical, dressing rooms, and sprinkler system and other repairs and renovations to the historic auditorium.
